definitions.gloss: Sesshū (1420–1506?), Zen monk and ink painter
definitions.explanation: A Zen monk of the Muromachi period, regarded as the greatest master of Japanese ink painting ({水墨画|すいぼくが}). He studied painting in Ming China, and works such as his long landscape scroll and {天橋立図|あまのはしだてず} are National Treasures.

examples.english: The story of the young Sesshū drawing a mouse with his tears even appears in textbooks.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A well-known legend tells how the boy Sesshū, tied to a pillar in his temple as punishment for drawing instead of studying, drew a mouse on the floor with his tears so lifelike that it seemed to move. He also designed gardens, and several temple gardens in western Japan are attributed to him.
